mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates and suppresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings support.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE) consistently correlate with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as job market weakness depresses consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above its 5-year median, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 90, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 90), supply chain disruptions depress corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) consistently signal strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of housing market level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
